text:
Noah (Sales): Handing off Aurelia Health (12mo Dedicated) 9: PoC green; procurement signed DPA; they need PHI model mount + Okta SSO + VPC peering.

Noah (Sales): Timeline: want go-live in ~30 days. Renewal risk low if no infra blockers; procurement asked for KMS/HSM ETA.

Priya (CS): I'll own onboarding. Owners: Priya (lead), Diego (peering/infra), Mira (smoke tests), Rita (support/runbook).

Diego (Infra): Need ASN + allowed CIDRs. HSM ETA for Dedicated ~5-7 weeks; KMS available now. Will post compliance note.

Mira (Solutions): I'll upload a 10-prompt smoke set and a tiny test harness to /shared/aurelia-tests. Curl sample for their infra team to smoke: curl -X POST https://dedicated.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-ded","input":"ping"}'

Rita (Support): I'll create ticket AU-110 "Aurelia onboarding" with checklist: SSO, SCIM, peering, model mount, smoke test, canary; will also prep 30d oncall plan.

ticket-bot: Ticket AU-110 created by Rita (Support) - https://support.redwood.ai/AU-110

Priya (CS): Action items: Noah-get ASN & contact; Diego-validate peering + KMS/HSM note; Mira-upload tests; Rita-ticket + runbook. I'll schedule kickoff Thu 14:00 UTC. Please add pre-kick docs to /shared/aurelia by Wed EOD.

Noah (Sales): Sending contact and ASN to Diego now. Also flagged conditional credit (8%) if p95 >300ms for first 60d; legal approved conditional language. Flagged in risk register.

Diego (Infra): Running a quick staging capacity test tomorrow; will post p95 numbers to AU-110. Preliminary expectation: ~200-250ms p95 @512 tokens on a40-class with batching.

Priya (CS): Great. Primary success metrics: go-live <=30d, p95 <300ms steady, smoke pass, zero Sev1 first 14d. Owners update AU-110 with progress.

Mira (Solutions): Uploaded tests; will attach results after peering and SSO.

Rita (Support): Drafted runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/aurelia-onboarding-runbook - please review.

Priya (CS): Thanks team 9 solid handoff. I'll compile a short risk register and share before kickoff.
